value.rationale: The Heawood graph is the unique cubic Fano-plane incidence object with full 336-fold point-line symmetry. Resolving all homology characters of its natural two-robot collision-free configuration space is a complete classification of meaningful intrinsic invariants: the previously unavailable degree-two module contains a six-dimensional irreducible in addition to the eight-dimensional graph-cycle module. Full-group, cyclic and polarity quotients have provably different homology. This is not merely a small Betti-number change, a parameter rename, or a known table recomputation.
